summary: Event-sourced partner attribution plus self-service affiliate dashboard plus conformance-first cross-rail DvP: OpenPartner pattern (raw events immutable, attribution a derived re-derivable view; four attribution models per campaign; first-party cookie + server-side identity stitching with late-binding backlog attribution; commission accrual + approve/reverse review queue + idempotent payouts; two-tier recruit commissions; product-scoped rules; click velocity limits + fraud-review replay; HMAC-SHA256 webhooks with redelivery; audit log in the same transaction; scoped API keys; OpenAPI spec generated from validators with drift-failing test; portable JSON+CSV+SQL export that round-trips; install wizard; admin personas with magic-link signin and last-active-admin guard; two-step sign-in); Raider pattern (self-service affiliate dashboard: affiliates generate tracking codes, see balance/statistics, request payouts; operator backend reports referred payments via token-guarded reporting API; default-secret rotation as an obligation — ideas only, MPL-2.0); OTAS cross-rail-dvp pattern (conformance-first: vectors define conformance, same fixture same reason code on every rail, one adapter per new rail; coarse additive reason-code registry with lint; canonical event envelope with declared finality; settlement lifecycle Proposed -> Committed -> Settled | Aborted with per-leg finality; capability manifest distinguishing chain-observed from issuer-declared behaviour; one verifier per seam plus reconcile). Patterns restated in our own words; no code copied. Feeds HALEX-AI referral attribution vocabulary, affiliate-registry discipline, and multi-rail conformance checking.
